name: Abhishek Saikia
bio_short: I write about technology, system internals and design, and the ideas shaping how we live. I also build tools, learn through experiments, and share my occasional thoughts.
bio_long: I'm Abhishek Saikia, a programmer and thinker based in India. I am currently in my final year of college.
I delve in backend and systems engineering - distributed systems, cloud, and computer internals. Comfortable in Go, TypeScript, Python, and a bit of Rust and C.
I write here irregularly but with intention.
If something I've written resonated with you, I'd genuinely love to hear about it. Connect with me!.
